speaker: Isadora
cn: （沉声）Damián，昨晚如果不是我去接你，你是不是就跟别人睡了？
en: (low voice) Damián, if I hadn't picked you up last night, would you have slept with someone else?

speaker: Damián
cn: 怎么可能。Isadora，你要相信我啊！
en: What are you on about Isadora? you have to believe me!

speaker: Isadora
cn: （傲娇）算你识相！（爬到Damián面前，看着Damián）昨晚表现不错，不跟你计较了。
en: (attacking) You're quite tactful! (Crawls up to Damián and looks at him) You were quite impressive last night. I won't hold it against you.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （笑）早安吻。
en: (laughs) Morning babe!

speaker: Isadora
cn: （笑）你要干什么？
en: (laughs) What are you doing?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （惊喜）没想到你的吻技也这么棒。
en: (Surprise) I didn't expect you're so good at kissing!

speaker: Damián
cn: 还有更棒的，今晚回来让你体验一下。
en: That’s not even the best part. Come back tonight and I’ll show you more.

speaker: Isadora
cn: 好啊，不过，你上班要迟到了吧？
en: Sure, but I figure... You're running late for work?

speaker: Damián
cn: 对了，你在哪里上班啊？
en: Oh right, where do you work?

speaker: Isadora
cn: 我在Casa Elorza，我是特助。
en: I work at Casa Elorza. I’m the executive assistant.

speaker: Damián
cn: 原来我们是同事啊。不过我只是信息部的小职员。
en: So we're actually colleagues? But I'm just a junior employee in the Information Department.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （挑眉）昨天临时顶上处理黑客那事的新人，不少人都听说了。
en: (raising an eyebrow) You’re the new guy who stepped in during that hacking incident yesterday, right? Word’s already gotten around about you.

speaker: Damián
cn: 对了，你是特助，应该认识总裁吧？
en: Right, you're the EA—you must know the CEO, right?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （试探）怎么？你有兴趣？
en: (tentatively) Yeah? Are you interested in the CEO?

speaker: Damián
cn: 怎么可能，我就是好奇问问。总裁身份那么高贵，我可不敢肖想。
en: Of course not. I was just curious. The CEO’s way out of my league. I wouldn’t dare get any ideas.

speaker: Isadora（VO）
cn: 看来，我要是现在告诉他我的真实身份会吓到他吧，算了，还是以后再说吧。
en: If I reveal my true identity now, he'll be intimidated. Forget it—let's wait till later.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （拿起手机）我们一起打车吧。
en: (Picks up her phone) Let's grab a cab?

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （试探）Damián，昨晚你没发生什么事吧？
en: (tentatively) Damián, everything okay last night?

speaker: Damián
cn: 我能有什么事？走开！
en: What could possibly go wrong? Get out!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （颐指气使）Damián，你这样我也不会原谅你的！但我已经答应你了，明天我们去登记处办手续吧。
en: (commanding) Don’t think I’ve forgiven you, Damián! But since I already agreed to marry you, we’ll go to the registry office tomorrow and make it official.

speaker: Damián
cn: （不耐烦）你脑子有问题吗？我说了，我已经领证了！你别纠缠我了！
en: (frustrated) Are you out of your mind? I've already got married! Stop pestering me and leave me alone!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 我纠缠？（怒）你以后别求着我嫁给你！
en: I'm pestering you? (Angry) Just don’t come crawling back, begging me to marry you!

speaker: Fernando（OS）
cn: （开心）Damián，告诉你个好消息，你父亲我要结婚了！
en: (Happy) Damián, guess what? Your old man's getting married!

speaker: Damián
cn: （不可置信）什么？
en: (In disbelief) What did you just say?
